impact_estimate._comment: Best-effort structured extraction from this candidate's own evidence text. Null any field you don't have evidence for - do not guess a number to fill the shape.

impact._comment: Typed fields for deterministic scoring (build-plan Batch 2), populated by the classify step from the candidate evidence it clustered. Null any field without real evidence. cargo_relevance_level drives the cargo-first triage sort; cargo_confirmed is true only for cargo_relevance_level = direct.

classified_event_output._timestamp_comment: Stamped by the ledger-append step with a real clock read (e.g. `date -u`), never invented by the workflow script or the classify subagent. See references/event-fingerprinting.md.
classified_event_output._council_comment: Set by the Council pass (references/threshold-rulebook.md), which independently re-reads Classify's output against the guidelines/thresholds and against the previous ledger line for this canonical_event_id, before the event is allowed into the digest. workflow_status reflects Council's final call, not Classify's initial one, when they differ. council_verdict is kept distinct from workflow_status so Classify-vs-Council disagreement rate is itself measurable over time. dark_corner_impact is a null-by-default supply-chain-propagation narrative (using service-dependency-graph.json + cargo-hub-tiers.json) - only set when there's a real, non-generic inference to draw; a migrated pre-Council line keeps council_verdict: not_reviewed and dark_corner_impact: null rather than a fabricated retroactive value.
